examples.title: Example 1: Setting Component Keyboard Shortcuts
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set up keyboard shortcuts for components. This allows users to press the modifier key and accompanying key at the same time to trigger the component to respond to the shortcut and trigger the onClick event or a custom event.

examples.title: Example 2: Binding and Unbinding Keyboard Shortcuts
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to bind and unbind keyboard shortcuts.
